meta.title: In Spring — Set 3
meta.subject: English Reading
meta.description: Details and nature observation quiz for 'In Spring'.

questions.question: Which animal has a baby called a fawn?
questions.explanation: A fawn is a baby deer. The story mentions fawns struggling to walk.

questions.question: Tadpoles swim underneath the melting ice of the pond.
questions.explanation: True. The text says: 'You can see tadpoles swimming beneath the pond's melting ice.'

questions.question: Where do flowers hide in spring?
questions.explanation: The text says: 'You can walk in the woods and spy flowers hiding behind trees.'

questions.question: In spring, you can run outside after breakfast with a thick winter coat.
questions.explanation: False. The text says: 'You can run outside after dinner without a coat' because the days are longer and warmer.

questions.question: What happens to the weather and day length in spring?
options: They stay the same as winter.
questions.explanation: In spring, days get warmer and the daylight lasts longer.

questions.question: You can watch squirrels _______ around the yard in spring.
questions.hint: Run or rush quickly and suddenly.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'You can watch squirrels dart around.'

questions.question: What are worms doing in the spring ground?
options: They are coiling up from underneath.
They are flying in the breezes.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'you can see worms coil up from underneath the wet ground.'

questions.question: Sort these spring occurrences into things you Feel or things you See in the story:
questions.explanation: You feel breezes and warmth. You see squirrels, worms, and fawns moving.

questions.question: A fawn struggles to walk because its legs are young and weak.
questions.explanation: True. Fawns are baby deer. Their young legs are not yet strong, so they struggle to stand and walk.

questions.question: Arrange the words to show what plants do:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'In spring plants start growing.' They grow after winter.

questions.question: Which season does spring welcome?
questions.explanation: The text says spring 'welcomes another' season, which is summer (heat of summer follows spring).

questions.question: To splash through wet puddles on the ground, you should wear _______.
questions.explanation: The text says: 'You can wear boots and splash through puddles.'

questions.question: Arrange the words to describe walking in spring:
questions.explanation: Correct sentence: 'We can walk in the woods.' In the woods, we spy hidden flowers.

questions.question: Spring waves good-bye to summer and welcomes winter.
questions.explanation: False. Spring waves good-bye to winter (cold) and welcomes summer (warmth).

questions.question: Why is spring called a bridge or link between seasons?
options: Because it has snow and hot sun at the same time.
Because it connects the cold of winter with the heat of summer.
Because it is the only season with rain.
Because we only walk in the woods.
questions.explanation: Spring lies in the middle of winter and summer, connecting the cold season we leave behind with the warm season we welcome.
